units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:29">Y. Peah I, 15ᶜ</cite> sq. <he>האיש ס׳ בידו וכ׳</he> the man has the power (possesses the means, to honor his parents) but the married woman not; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:7:5">Y. Kidd. I, 61ᵃ</cite> bot.; Bab.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 30b">Kidd. 30ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="O00803"><he>סֵיפֶק</he></cite>; <cite ref="Kiddushin 35a">ib. 35ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Kiddushin 1:11">Tosef. ib. I, 11</cite> <cite ref="O01406"><he>סֵפֶק</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:15:1">Koh. R. to I, 15</cite> <he>שהיתה ספיקא בידך וכ׳</he> thou didst have an opportunity to repent.
